headline: Approval of agenda and consent agenda, including 2026-2027 First and Third Class Liquor License Renewals.
summary: The meeting will consider adopting the agenda and consent agenda. The consent agenda includes approval of the 2026-2027 First and Third Class Liquor License Renewals as listed.
